summary: M3.S3 ImmobilCloud Mappa interattiva + Filtri avanzati — full backend + frontend validation. Backend: 14/14 pytest tests PASS covering /api/cloud/map (no filters, bbox in/out, invalid bbox 400, operation+price range, bedrooms_min+energy_class combined, invalid energy_class 422), /api/cloud/search advanced filters (bedrooms_min, bathrooms_min, energy_class valid/invalid, lat/lng in cards), geocoding fire-and-forget on POST and on PATCH (Nominatim worked within poll window — coords populated). Frontend: 18/18 Playwright assertions PASS — filter-bedrooms-min and filter-energy-class selects present with correct options (1-5+ / A4..G), URL updates with bedrooms_min and energy_class params on change, view-toggle-list and view-toggle-map render, switching to Mappa hides search-results-list and shows property-map-view, .leaflet-container renders, active button gets bg #0B1E3F, marker rendered for the single property with coords (Roma), clicking marker opens map-popup-<id> with map-popup-link-<id>, toggling back to Lista hides map and restores list.
critical_code_review_comments: public_portal.py /map endpoint correctly enforces lat/lng != null via {$ne: None, $exists: True} and parses bbox into 4 floats with proper 400 on malformed input (also covers partial like '41,12,42' because tuple unpack raises ValueError).
Pydantic regex on energy_class (A4|A3|A2|A1|A|B|C|D|E|F|G) properly rejects invalid classes with 422 — works on both /map and /search.

geocoding.schedule_geocode uses asyncio.create_task with a RuntimeError guard for non-loop contexts (e.g. tests), and the create/update handlers call it only when lat/lng absent (create) or address fields actually change (update). Nominatim User-Agent is set per usage policy.
/api/cloud/search LIST_FIELDS now includes lat/lng and _to_card surfaces them — confirmed by test seeding a property with explicit coords and reading them back via /search.

PropertyMapView correctly uses react-leaflet Marker+Popup with data-testid={`map-popup-${id}`} and link testid. The 'map-empty-hint' overlay path was not exercised live (DB has properties with coords) but the component code is consistent.

Minor (non-blocking): /api/cloud/map filter for rooms_min is supported by backend but the SearchPage UI does not pass rooms_min to the /map endpoint context — only filters that are also in the URL/state flow through. Not in scope of this iteration.

Minor: /api/cloud/map does not validate bbox numeric ranges (e.g. lat in [-90, 90], lng in [-180, 180]) — out-of-range values yield empty results silently. Acceptable but worth a follow-up Pydantic validator.
seed_data_creation: 3 TEST_M3S3_* properties created via POST /api/app/properties with explicit lat/lng (2 inside Roma bbox, 1 in Milano outside bbox); 2 more TEST_M3S3_geo_* properties created without coords to trigger Nominatim geocoding. All cleaned up at fixture teardown via DELETE /api/app/properties/{id}.
context_for_next_testing_agent: M3.S3 fully validated. Backend regression file: /app/backend/tests/test_immobilcloud_m3s3_map.py (14 tests, fully self-contained: seeds + cleans). Nominatim geocoding worked live during testing (Italian addresses resolve fast); tests are tolerant and pytest.skip if external API rate-limited. The DB had 1 pre-existing property with coords (Roma 'Appartamento Centro Storico Roma' from earlier backfill); seed adds 2 more inside Roma bbox + 1 Milano. Frontend testid contract verified: filter-bedrooms-min, filter-energy-class, view-toggle-list, view-toggle-map, search-results-list, property-map-view, .leaflet-container, map-popup-<id>, map-popup-link-<id>. The map-empty-hint overlay was not visually exercised (always had marker(s)) but the component code path is present and correct.
rca of the issue: No issues found. All M3.S3 features (map endpoint, bbox filter, advanced filters on /search, geocoding fire-and-forget, list/map toggle UI, Leaflet integration, popups) are functional end-to-end.
